description: This file is a shell script used for testing the handling of commit and tag messages with CRLF (Carriage Return and Line Feed) line endings in git. It defines functions to create refs with CRLF messages, runs various tests to verify that the message content and formatting are handled correctly with different git commands, and uses test assertions to validate behavior.

methods.name: create_crlf_ref
methods.description: Creates a git ref with a message containing CRLF line endings, and sets up associated subject and body text files.

methods.name: create_crlf_refs
methods.description: Creates multiple refs with CRLF messages and different structures for testing.

methods.name: test_crlf_subject_body_and_contents
methods.description: Runs a series of tests to verify that git commands output messages with CRLF endings correctly, checking subject, body, and message contents.
